retrievalProfile.description: A split-field layout featuring a white header with ultra-condensed sans-serif typography above a large-scale, low-key portrait.
triggerTerms: split white header and dark photo

recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1960s record sleeve composition characterized by a stark white top banner containing heavy, condensed sans-serif text in two colors, positioned above a square-format, dark-background portrait of a smiling subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal division between white text field and dark photographic field
Scale contrast between massive header text and smaller tracklist text
Color coordination between secondary header text and subject's clothing accents
Tight vertical stacking of display typography
coreInvariants: White background for the top third of the composition
Dark, low-key lighting for the photographic subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered in the bottom two-thirds, appearing from the chest up at a large scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The primary artist name in the top left corner acts as the heaviest visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large dark text, drop to the red sub-header, then move to the subject's face before scanning the right-aligned tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The white header provides breathing room for the dense typography, while the dark background isolates the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (header background and small metadata text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Red (secondary header and subject's scarf)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the header; low value, high saturation accents in the lower field.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, white, and one primary accent color

characterSpecificRedesigns: G and S have very tight apertures
M and N have vertical sides with no flare
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic sans-serif family using weight and color for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule-like alignment of text blocks

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for the primary header.
Offers the specific mid-century wood-type inspired condensed look.
Matches the grotesque sans-serif skeleton of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key studio portrait of a person smiling, with a dark textured background. Leave the top 25% of the image as a solid white rectangular banner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the white banner, place large ultra-condensed black sans-serif text in the top left. Below it, place medium-sized red condensed sans-serif text. On the right side of the banner, place a multi-line list of text in small black sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the top banner solid white?
Is the portrait lighting low-key with a dark background?
Is the secondary text color coordinated with the subject's clothing?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (red can be swapped for blue or gold)
Number of lines in the tracklist
mustRedesign: Overlapping text on the subject's face
postGenerationChecks: Check that the white banner is perfectly horizontal.
Ensure the black text is significantly larger than the red text.
Verify the subject is centered and looking slightly off-camera.
Confirm no text bleeds into the photographic area.
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-field layout [White Header 25% / Dark Photo 75%] + Ultra-Condensed Grotesque Sans-Serif + Primary/Accent Color Pairing.
